comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper versus remove and place a glass pane using two suction lifters.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine rotary tool use and response-based tuning; record attaches and locks two suction cups, performs synchronized bimanual lifting, carries a fragile pane level, and releases the lifters.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two energy-qualified stops; record requires the pane lifted with both cups locked, placed flat on felt bearers, lifters unlocked, and no drop, excessive tilt, or direct gripper contact.
comparison.reason: Fragile-load attachment and coordinated transport test a materially different ability. Candidate response and drift criteria are incompletely quantified.
